{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Clean revenue: remove commas and convert to float
df['revenue_clean'] = df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Filter out QA test orders (revenue = 999999.99)
qa_mask = df['revenue_clean'] == 999999.99

# Filter out refunded orders
refunded_mask = df['status'] == 'refunded'

# Apply filters: keep only completed orders and non-QA orders
filtered_df = df[~qa_mask & ~refunded_mask]

# Compute conversion rate for each channel
channel_conv = filtered_df.groupby('channel')['converted'].mean()

# Extract conversion rates
email_conv = channel_conv['email']
paid_search_conv = channel_conv['paid_search']

# Compute raw difference
raw_difference = email_conv - paid_search_conv

# Print required values explicitly
print(f"Number of QA test orders: {qa_mask.sum()}")
print(f"Number of refunded orders: {refunded_mask.sum()}")
print(f"Number of rows after filtering: {filtered_df.shape[0]}")
print(f"Email conversion rate (overall): {email_conv}")
print(f"Paid search conversion rate (overall): {paid_search_conv}")
print(f"Raw difference (email - paid_search): {raw_difference}")"}
